name: chess
description: A powerful, web-based chess analysis application powered by the **Stockfish** engine.  Import games directly from Chess.com, visualize evaluation trends with real-time graphs, and perform deep game reviews with move quality classification.

scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && node index.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
